record.title: Santa Rosa–Chacalluta renewed and intermittent migrant blockade, 29 April 2023
record.scope: Road connection between Santa Rosa and Chacalluta
record.direction: Both directions affected; Arica-to-Tacna lane later reopened while opposite lane remained blocked.
record.exceptions: Traffic reopened temporarily and later in one direction.
record.enforcement: People and objects obstructed the roadway.
record.relationship: Recurrence after documented 25 April clearance in R3-AM-010; not a new state-wide immigration closure.
record.status_observation: Status limited to dated evidence; no claim of present closure.
record.official_rationale: Protesters sought permission to enter and transit Peru on return journeys.
record.context: Morning obstruction lasted more than six hours; afternoon clearance was followed by another blockage and one-direction restoration.
record.uncertainty: One day contains multiple movements and renewed obstruction. Endpoint is a partial milestone, not final resolution; no continuous daily duration.
